newsitem.title: UK: Hyatt eyes Lonrho hotels - paper.
newsitem.headline: Hyatt eyes Lonrho hotels - paper.

text.p: Hyatt Hotels Corp has held talks with Lonrho Plc to buy its Princess chain of luxury hotels, a British newspaper said on Sunday.
The Observer said Hyatt had held informal talks about buying the 10-strong hotel chain, estimated to be worth 350 million stg ($562 million).

Hyatt, owned by Chicago's Pritzker family, announced last week it would spend $1.0 billion over the next three years to acquire between 20 and 30 hotels and resorts in the United States, Canada and the Caribbean.
Last week The Observer reported Lonrho had cancelled a deal that gave Saudi investor Prince al-Waleed bin Talal exclusive negotiating rights in his bid to buy the Princess hotels.

Lonrho officials were not available for comment on Sunday, but last week said there had always been several parties interested in the Princess hotel chain, the sale of which is part of Lonrho's plan to focus on its mining interests.
